conversations.value: What is APXM in one sentence?
APXM compiles agent skills to a typed graph IR and reusable artifact, the way functions compile to object files.
Because the same artifact runs across deployments with reproducible sessions, enforced capabilities, and compiler diagnostics that compound across every existing skill.
Explain prefix caching in one paragraph.

Prefix caching stores attention key/value tensors for shared prompt prefixes so subsequent requests that begin with the same tokens skip re-encoding that prefix; for multi-turn or fan-out workloads this turns repeated prefix work into a single computation.

Eviction under KV memory pressure, an explicit reset (e.g. POST /v1/apxm/admin/reset_prefix_cache on the APXM fork), or any token-level difference earlier in the prompt that breaks the shared-prefix match.
Give three deployment shapes APXM's zoo supports.
Single-node single-instance, single-node multi-instance with GPU groups, and same-model multi-instance replicas across nodes for throughput.
Which shape exercises prefix-cache sharing across tenants the most?

Multi-instance same-model with a shared system prompt across tenants — each tenant hits a different replica but the system-prompt prefix is identical, so each replica's local cache deduplicates that prefix across its own tenant pool.
